Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients at high-risk for an acute myocardial infarction, including any 2 of these risk factors: males age > 45; females age >55; family history of premature coronary heart disease (CHD); current cigarette smoker; hypertension; or elevated total cholesterol with low HDL and/or high LDL. OR have: - Active angina (chest pain due to coronary heart disease) - History of coronary heart disease according to the treating physician - Past history of myocardial infarction documented by electrocardiogram or arteriography - Diabetes Mellitus - Renal dialysis
